name: JIR-Arena
description: JIR-Arena is the first comprehensive multimodal benchmark dataset for Just-in-time Information Recommendation (JIR) systems. It evaluates JIR systems on their ability to infer user information needs, provide timely and relevant recommendations, and avoid irrelevant content across diverse real-world scenarios.
reputation: A very recent benchmark from the JIR-Arena paper, so it is not yet widely adopted but is positioned as a first comprehensive dataset for this task.
notes: Includes 34 scenes with 831 minutes of data covering 11 types of information needs; uses a multi-turn validation framework and static knowledge bases for reproducible evaluation.
